title: Four Letters and One Visit
subtitle: 事务与事件 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 事务与事件（社会服务与人际沟通·公共事务）
meta: 主题语境：事务与事件（社会服务与人际沟通·公共事务）　|　核心词汇：affair　|　正文 321 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 affair 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my grandfather was asked to mind the ① affairs of a town of nine thousand people, which he did for four years and never once called work. He said an affair is a thing that is not yours and that you are responsible for, and that this is the definition of the job and of most of a life; affairs, he said, are what other people's lives are made of.

The ② foreign affairs of the town, meaning the twinning with a French village in 1966, took four letters and nine months and produced one visit. There was ③ an affair of the rates in 1968, by which the newspaper meant a mistake, and my grandfather said an affair is what a newspaper calls a mistake when it wants it to sound like a story.

My grandmother read ④ current affairs for forty years and said the phrase meant the same four things in a different order. There was ⑤ an affair in our own street in 1971, which everybody knew and nobody named, and she said a private affair is the only kind that is ever truly public.

The ⑥ affair, meaning the one in the street, ended in 1974 with two houses sold and a child who never learned the truth. My grandfather said the ⑦ state of affairs in the town had been the same since 1946 and would be the same in 1996, and he said it without bitterness; an affair, he said, always ends with somebody moving.

The ⑧ affair of honour he refused in 1979, meaning a duel of letters with the editor, was the only thing he ever refused, and he said refusing is the whole of the job. The ⑨ affair I would put in a newspaper, if I were one, is the four letters and nine months and one visit; the ⑩ affair that was never named in our street is the only one I have ever wanted to name.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 事务；事情（常复数 affairs）
B. n. 事件；事情（引起关注的事件）
C. n. 风流韵事；私通事件
D. n. （个人的）私事；私事一桩
E. 固定搭配：foreign / international affairs 外交／国际事务
F. 固定搭配：current affairs 时事
G. 固定搭配：an affair of honour 荣誉攸关之事；（旧时）决斗
H. 固定搭配：state of affairs 事态；状况

items.q: the affairs of a town of nine thousand
The foreign affairs of the town
an affair of the rates in 1968
an affair in our own street
The affair, meaning the one in the street
the state of affairs in the town
The affair of honour he refused
The affair I would put in a newspaper
the affair that was never named

answers.why: affairs 意为“事务”，1963 年祖父受托管理一个九千人小镇的事务，干了四年却从不称之为工作。
foreign affairs 意为“外交事务”，镇上唯一的外交事务是 1966 年与一个法国村庄结为友好城镇。
affair 意为“事件”，1968 年那起税率事件，报纸说的其实只是一个错误。
current affairs 意为“时事”，祖母读了四十年时事，她说所谓时事就是同样四件事换个顺序。
affair 意为“私事”，1971 年我们那条街上有一桩私事，人人都知道，谁也不说破。
affair 意为“风流韵事、私通事件”，那桩 1971 年的事 1974 年以两户卖房收场，只有一个孩子始终不知道真相。
state of affairs 意为“事态、状况”，祖父说镇上的状况自 1946 年以来一直如此，到 1996 年也不会变。
an affair of honour 意为“荣誉攸关之事”，1979 年他拒绝与编辑打一场笔战，那是他唯一拒绝过的一次。
affair 意为“事件”，若我是报纸，我要登的事件是那四封信、九个月和一次访问。
affair 意为“风流韵事”，我们那条街上那桩从未被点名的韵事，是唯一一件我曾想点名的事。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年祖父受托管理一个九千人小镇的事务，他干了四年，从不称之为工作。（affairs）
1966 年镇上唯一的外交事务是与一个法国村庄结为友好城镇。（foreign affairs）
1968 年那起税率事件，报纸说的其实只是一个错误。（affair）
祖母读了四十年时事，她说所谓时事就是同样四件事换个顺序。（current affairs）
他说镇上的状况自 1946 年以来一直如此，到 1996 年也不会变。（state of affairs）
1979 年他拒绝的那场荣誉之争，是他一生中唯一拒绝过的事。（an affair of honour）
answers: In 1963 my grandfather was asked to mind the affairs of a town of nine thousand people, and he did it for four years.
The only foreign affairs of the town were the twinning with a French village in 1966.
There was an affair of the rates in 1968, by which the newspaper meant a mistake.
My grandmother read current affairs for forty years and said it meant the same four things in a different order.
He said the state of affairs in the town had been the same since 1946 and would be the same in 1996.
The affair of honour he refused in 1979 was the only thing he ever refused.
